value.title: Phase 3: Guarded amp control and cut-over
value.summary: Safety policy test-first, live switch, supervised cut-over with rollback.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom. Hardware smoke steps that take the knob from the Mac or touch the amp wait for Vaughan's go-ahead.

value.title: RED: native policy/executor tests with Test Doc blocks (fake BluOS transport + fake clock): action→command table; every step does a fresh successful /Volume read first and refuses on missing/invalid dB; increase refused past max_db incl. amp changed externally since last poll; decrease allowed; mute toggle reads fresh mute state; source switch sets safe dB; dry-run emits no writes; events older than 1 s or queued before a live/dry-run or link transition are dropped; a write with a lost/timed-out response is never retried; command-path backoff after failures
value.receipt: test_amp_policy: 11 tests with Test Doc blocks, RED 11/11 failed on stub; FakeAmp models dB/mute/source/lost responses

value.title: GREEN: knob_core policy + executor (fresh read before each write, fail closed, no write replay, stale-event expiry); BluOS write adapter (/Volume?db=, /Volume?mute=, /Play?inputTypeIndex=, Spotify via sources lookup + /Play?url=, /Volume?abs_db=)
value.success: Policy tests green; adapter mirrors scripts/bluos_*.py endpoints

value.title: Screen v3: big dB + bar against the cap on turn, cap-blocked flash, mute/source confirmations, DRY-RUN/LIVE badge
value.receipt: display_ui.cpp: DRY-RUN/LIVE badge, dB+bar to max_db, red MAX on refusal, MUTED/UNMUTED, Optical/Spotify, failure + dry-run lines; builds + renders (dry-run flash)

value.title: Live switch: serial `live on` requires the confirmation phrase; live state persisted in NVS (owner decision: remember LIVE); `live off` instant and persisted; switching mode flushes the event queue
value.success: Live mode only after explicit confirm; badge reflects it; reboot returns to DRY-RUN
value.receipt: Serial: fresh boot live=false; wrong/missing phrase refused; live on <phrase> → reboot → live=1; live off → reboot → live=0; queue flushed on change (control_flush)

value.title: Docs: docs/how/esp32-bridge.md (flash, pair, Wi-Fi, go live, cut-over, rollback to Mac daemon, clear bonds) + README "Run it on an ESP32"
value.receipt: docs/how/esp32-bridge.md (flash, pair, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz, screen, going live, safety rules, console, cut-over, rollback); README 'Run it on an ESP32' + intro updated; just fw-live/fw-dry-run/fw-status

value.title: Supervised cut-over (Vaughan's go-ahead): unload Mac launchd daemon, dry-run check, live on, step down/up near cap, mute, both sources; then rollback rehearsal
value.success: Recorded in execution log; amp never exceeded max_db

tk-2301.assertion: just fw-test red on policy assertions
Lost-response, stale-event, overflow-burst and dry-run→live cases present

tk-2303.assertion: Cap flash shown when refusal happens (dry-run test)

tk-2304.assertion: Fresh device boots DRY-RUN; after `live on <phrase>` + reboot it boots LIVE; after `live off` + reboot it boots DRY-RUN
